title: Junior Engineer, Clerk Typist and Other – 156 Posts
salary_range: Pay Matrix Level S-6 to S-15 (₹19900 - ₹132300)
age_limit: Minimum 18 years, Maximum 38 years for Open category and 43 years for Backward Classes as of 2026-11-01 (relaxations applicable per rules).
summary: Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation (VVCMC) has announced direct recruitment for 156 Group-C technical and non-technical posts including Junior Engineers, Clerk Typists, and other positions. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official VVCMC website from November 26, 2026, until December 17, 2026. Selection will be based on an online examination and fulfillment of prescribed educational and category-specific criteria.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must possess the specific educational qualification and relevant experience mandated for the applied post.
Age limits apply as of November 1, 2026, with relaxations for reserved categories, project/earthquake affected, and other eligible groups.
Valid email ID and mobile number are mandatory throughout the recruitment process.

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official VVCMC website at www.vvcmc.in.
Review the detailed notification, eligibility conditions, and guidelines carefully.
Register using a valid email ID and mobile number and fill out the online application form.
Upload required documents, certificates, and photographs as specified.
Pay the applicable online application fee before the deadline.
Submit the final application and retain a printed copy for future reference.
